description: The FULL overnight continuation read: all top-5 session-momentum coins into the 20:00 UTC signal (81-coin Robinhood-tradable universe), the BTC 200-day regime gate state, the pre/post-signal phase clock, eligibility counts and the registered rule + study receipts (gross edge, null comparison, the retail-fee REFUTATION and breakeven bps, attached to every read). ~15-min refresh, 24/7. Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
name: get_crypto_night_live
